source: The manual does not present the Research Lineage names as a single list. Each name was extracted from the individual profile's Research Lineage field, one per profile, CIS-01 through CIS-50, in the manual at lines 238-5537 (one field per profile heading; the deployment rule naming this field is at line 31). Names are reproduced exactly as printed in those fields, in profile order.
